def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    marker = next((r, c) for r, c in pts if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1)
    mr, mc = marker
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            d = max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
    out[mr][mc] = 3
    return out
PY
